description: This file contains the implementation of the CellFormatRenderer class, which is responsible for rendering cell formatting information such as shading, borders, padding, and merging in RTF documents within the MigraDoc library. It interacts with other rendering components and accesses document structure elements to produce the correct RTF code for table cells.

classes.name: CellFormatRenderer
classes.description: A renderer class for outputting the formatting of a table cell, including borders, shading, padding, and merging flags, into RTF format.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Renders the cell's borders, shading, padding, and merge flags into RTF commands.

methods.name: RenderLeftRightPadding
methods.description: Renders the left and right padding controls for the cell.

methods.name: GetRightCellBoundary
methods.description: Calculates the right boundary position of the cell in RTF units.
